author: The Buddhist siddhas of eastern India
description: Songs of the Buddhist siddhas in Old Bengali, with the Sanskrit commentary of Munidatta.

witnesses.citation: Haraprasad Shastri, ed., Hājār bacharer purāṇa bāṅgālā bhāṣāy bauddha gān o dohā (Calcutta: Baṅgīya Sāhitya Pariṣat, 1916), under the title Caryācaryaviniścaya; songs with Munidatta's commentary, from the Nepal palm-leaf manuscript.
witnesses.label: Nepal manuscript, ed. Shastri 1916
witnesses.note: Transcribed from Bengali Wikisource's 1916 edition pages (proofread against the page scans). The edition is public domain; the Wikisource transcription is credited in the page footer. Bracketed numbers in the commentary ([২], [২ক]) are the manuscript's folio numbers, and bracketed letters are Shastri's restorations.

witnesses.citation: Spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa (Caryāgītikoṣavṛtti), Degé Tengyur, Toh 2293; translated by Kīrticandra and Yarlung Lotsāwa Drakpa Gyaltsen. Preserves songs 24, 25 and 48 and the end of 23, which the Nepal manuscript lacks.
witnesses.label: Tibetan translation, Toh 2293
